name: follower
_why: The change-detection decoder on the board (spec, 'Is this still the same tune?'): the three trackers and their notes as in fuse3, then the follower in place of the intervals, matcher, prior and assembler. Every 4 s it scores a pool of candidates on the latest 6 s of notes with the bench's ChunkScorer and steps the bench's Decoder (its defaults, tuned on seven nights). Scheduler 'always': the decoder's belief is near certain quickly, and skipping the trackers when confident would leave it deaf.
